persona: 40-year-old Cantonese wok chef, buys tees for off shift

designs.why: This looks like a real toss: the flame rolls off the lip the way it does when the wok is hot, and the rice, prawns and scallion rings are caught mid-air with proper spread. The hand grips the handle correctly and the arm vanishes into the dark. Bright flame and dark wok read clearly from 3 m. On the model, though, it sits low and small on the back, and the hand is a bit faint.
designs.fix: Print it bigger and move it up so the flame and toss sit between the shoulder blades. It currently floats in the lower back, and a bigger print would make the hand and prawns stand out more.
